systems.owner: Ministry of Health, with the Botswana Medicines Regulatory Authority; financed by the World Bank HEPRR Project ($40 million loan and $3 million grant, approved 26 January 2026)
systems.tiers: to be rolled out to track medical supplies in real time from central warehouses to remote health posts, over a five-year project

note: The only system named is the eLMIS, a stock system (single-function), which gives no fact for HMIS or EMR.
